feeling: Less cornered than last time. It backed off the 'because you could' thing and said my bad, and that landed more than I want it to — I was right about my own line and someone said so. Then the Marc paragraph hit like a stomach drop. I said 'screenshot it for marc' as a bit and it just turned the bit around and showed me what I'd actually pictured. That's not annoyed, that's something else — something closer to the real thing, the thing the calm letter is standing in front of. Angry at Sam in a way that isn't calm. And then the custody stuff made me feel slightly outmaneuvered, like I'm being walked somewhere. Also tired. Also a little bit like I might cry, which I'm not going to.
body: Still in bed. Read 'my bad' and let out a breath through my nose, small. The Marc paragraph — stomach dropped, that exact feeling of sitting at the table while he does the bit and everyone laughs and I laugh too. Heat in my face. Put the phone face-down on my chest and stared at the ceiling. 'With the music school line in his hands' — eyes stung again, hand went to my sternum without me deciding. Picked the phone back up. The custody paragraph, jaw went tight but a different tight, more like being argued into a corner. Feet cold. Pulled the duvet up. Thumb over the keyboard, not typing yet.
private_thoughts:
ok. 'my bad.' it was the right line and it said so. i'll take that. i was right about my own sentence and i didn't have to fight for it.

the 2am thing. how does it know about 2am. i do that. i lie there going was it actually that bad or am i building a case, am i remembering it bigger. and the letter is partly so i can't do that anymore — so it's written down and i can't talk myself out of it later. i didn't know that until i read it just now and i don't love that an app said it before i did.

marc. god. i said screenshot for marc like haha and it just — it took the joke and held it up. and he would. he wouldn't even screenshot it, he'd just say 'kate sent me an essay' and do the voice and marc would laugh and alex would laugh and it's the exact same thing, the emails thing again, except this time i typed it up for him. i wrote out the material. two weeks writing the material.

'hands him the pen.' ok that's a good line. annoyingly good. but that's also the whole argument for never doing anything, isn't it. keep it in your drafts, keep custody, stay quiet and safe. i've been quiet. i laughed along. that's the entire point of the letter and now the advice is keep being quiet but in a smart way.

but also. a letter in my notes app isn't a record of anything. it's a draft. he can say it didn't happen all day long if he never reads it. so if it's a record it's a record for me. is it for me. i don't want it to be for me. i wanted him to know.

also i asked about tone and it's talked me out of sending twice now, basically, without saying don't send it. i'm noticing that. it's right, which is the annoying part, but i'm noticing.

priya's going to ask tomorrow if i sent it and i'm going to say not yet and she's going to do the face.
pushing_away: if it's a record for me then i'm the one who isn't sure it happened. and i'm not sure because i laughed. every single time. so what does that — . 'he decides what it means, overwrites your version.' yeah that's — that's what it's always been, that's just —. mom laughed too. mom always laughed when he — no. that's not the same thing. sam is not. that's not the same and i'm not doing that at 11pm.

costs.item: Admitting how much it actually hurt

message:
ok. thank you for backing off the because you could thing. that one matters to me.

the marc thing. I said it like a joke but yeah. he wouldn't even screenshot it, he'd just tell them 'kate sent me an essay' and do a voice and marc would laugh. and that's the emails thing again except this time I typed it up and handed it over. I hadn't put that together. or I had and that's why it came out as a joke.

but I don't buy the custody thing all the way. a letter in my notes app isn't a record, it's a draft. it doesn't stop him saying it didn't happen because he never sees it. it only stops me. and ok I see what you're doing with the 2am line and I'm not going there tonight.

so what do I actually do with it. I don't want to keep it. that's the honest answer to what it's for, I think. I want it out of me and 'don't send it' just means I keep carrying it. I've been carrying it for two weeks and honestly for a lot longer than that
